column3: The data in this sheet is used in generating the SECIM report. It is identical to data included in the other sheets, but positive and negative ionization mode data are combined and redundant results have been removed. Data in this sheet can be linked to the complete lists of analyzed peaks in other sheets by the "row.mode" column. In the case of >2 classes, there is one row per contrast for each included peak. Even if an ANOVA or LMM was performed, the statistical results in this sheet are from the means comparison test(s).
The unique peak identifier including the peak's row and ionization mode. This field can be used to link a result to the complete (un-reduced) results in other sheets.
Compound name as identified by SECIM internal database or HMDB (via R package metid). If peak could not be identified by either method, the peak's mz_RT is used.
ANOVA model term being evaluated for means comparison
Confidence level of ID (1 for peaks identified with SECIM database, 3 if HMDB via metid.)
metid: total score (same as mz match score when RT is not used for matching)
